skill.name: json-transformer
skill.description: Transform, validate, query, compare, and convert JSON data with practical Python, JavaScript, jq, and schema examples.
skill.summary: A practical guide for reshaping JSON, validating schemas, extracting data, and converting formats.
skill.author: CuriousLearner

security_audit.summary: The static findings were reviewed against the full SKILL.md content. They are false positives from markdown code fences, tutorial examples, sample file operations, and keyword matches; no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, hidden execution path, or malicious behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Sample commands and file writes may be copied without considering local file impact.
remediation.suggestion: Add short guidance to run examples only on trusted sample files and to review output paths before writing converted files.

remediation.issue: Configuration merge examples can overwrite base settings by design.
remediation.suggestion: Document that callers should validate allowed configuration keys before merging untrusted user configuration.

content.value_statement: JSON work often requires validation, reshaping, extraction, and conversion across tools. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical patterns for common JSON transformations.
actual_capabilities: Parse, validate, pretty-print, and compact JSON data.
Flatten and unflatten nested JSON objects and arrays.
Extract values with JSONPath, JMESPath, jq, and safe path access patterns.
Merge, diff, compare, sort, group, and deduplicate JSON structures.
Convert JSON to CSV, YAML, and XML using common Python and jq workflows.
Generate simple JSON Schema definitions from sample data.
limitations: It is a guidance skill and does not provide a packaged executable tool.
Large files may require streaming approaches beyond the included examples.
Examples assume trusted local files unless the user adds extra validation.
Generated schemas may need manual refinement for production contracts.

use_cases.title: Clean API payloads
use_cases.description: Reshape nested API responses into simpler records for application use or reporting.

use_cases.title: Prepare analysis datasets
use_cases.description: Flatten nested JSON and convert it into CSV or YAML for analysis workflows.

use_cases.title: Validate integration contracts
use_cases.description: Create or apply JSON Schema checks before data moves between services.

prompt_templates.title: Format and validate JSON
prompt_templates.prompt: Use json-transformer to validate this JSON, explain any errors, and return a clean formatted version.

prompt_templates.title: Extract selected fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Use json-transformer to extract the user names, email addresses, and active status from this nested JSON structure.

prompt_templates.title: Convert nested JSON to a table
prompt_templates.prompt: Use json-transformer to flatten this JSON and describe how to convert the result into a CSV table.

prompt_templates.title: Design a transformation pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use json-transformer to design a repeatable pipeline that validates, merges, normalizes keys, and diffs these JSON documents.

output_examples.input: A nested customer profile with addresses, orders, and status fields.
output_examples.output: A flattened field list, a normalized customer summary, and validation notes for missing optional fields.

output_examples.input: Two versions of a service configuration document.
output: A summary of changed values and recommended review points.

output_examples.input: An array of event records that must be grouped by category.
output_examples.output: A grouped summary with counts per category and a suggested jq or Python approach.

best_practices: Validate JSON before applying transformations or conversions.
Keep transformations idempotent and test them with empty, null, and missing values.
Review file paths before writing converted outputs to local disk.
anti_patterns: Do not transform untrusted configuration without checking allowed keys first.
Do not assume generated schemas fully capture business rules.
Do not load very large JSON files into memory without considering streaming parsers.

faq.question: Does this skill run a JSON transformer program?
faq.answer: No. It provides reusable instructions and examples that Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can apply.

faq.question: Can it validate JSON against a schema?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes JSON Schema validation patterns for Python and JavaScript.

faq.question: Can it convert JSON to CSV?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows pandas, csv module, and jq approaches for CSV conversion.

faq.question: Does it support jq-style transformations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes jq command examples and Python pyjq examples for filtering, grouping, and mapping.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive JSON data?
faq.answer: Use it only in trusted workspaces and avoid exposing secrets in prompts or generated examples.

faq.question: Can it handle very large JSON files?
faq.answer: It mentions memory limits, but large files may need streaming parsers not fully covered by the examples.
